arguments.message:
Sure! You can share any dashboard as a read‑only public link:
1. Open the dashboard and click the **Share** menu.
2. Choose the option to create a public link – no Meridian account or sign‑in is required for the recipient.
3. The link stays live and updates in real time, so anyone who revisits it sees the latest data.
4. If you ever need to stop access, return to the same Share menu and revoke the link; it will be invalidated immediately.
Let me know if you need any help locating the Share menu or revoking a link later.
